your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: Opener $120. If uncontested, cheap block of p3 yellow (list $280) and I still have $304 for Virginia ($160). Ceiling if I must win to deny the set: ~$180–200; above that prefer p4 to buy or p3 to overpay. p3 can still put 1 house on each yellow if they pay under ~$446 by mortgaging Baltic/Illinois/Pacific, so denial beats mere price-raising. Don't chase past $200 — cash must cover Virginia and mid rents. Keep Tennessee as orange blocker. Don't fund p1.

Drop. Bid is $300, above my $200 ceiling. Winning Marvin doesn't complete a set and leaves me unable to buy Virginia ($160) to finish pinks. p4 at $300 already blocks p3; if p3 outbids they bleed build cash. Keep $424 + Tennessee as orange blocker. Don't fund p1.

Anchor Kentucky at $100. p1 ends at $146, cannot buy a $200 dark-blue house even if they take it. Hard ceiling $150 so they stay under $200. If they counter above that, walk. Goal is 2/3 red with Indiana, then later Illinois from p3 only if the price doesn't fund multiple yellow houses. Don't mortgage. Don't give pinks or Tennessee.

No set, no build. Don't mortgage — $398 must cover Virginia ($160) and mid rents (Oriental/Vermont 4h $450 needs a small mortgage; BW 3h $1400 is already fatal even fully mortgaged). p1 won't sell Kentucky at any price that doesn't also fund a BW house ($200); don't rebid. Don't give States/St. Charles (pink needs only bank Virginia). Don't sell Tennessee (blocks p4 orange) or give p3 cash (yellow set, $147, one mortgage from a house). Next: buy VA/NY/B&O/NC/PA if landed; keep blocking.

Drop. Penn doesn't complete a set for anyone: p3 already has Pacific but only $147, so they can't beat $150; NC is still bank. Winning at $151+ is a stranded tile and cuts the $160 I need for Virginia to finish pink. p4 owning it at $150 doesn't create a monopoly. Keep $398, Tennessee as the orange block, and don't fund p3's yellow houses.

Counter $120, hard ceiling $122. At $123+ p3 can mortgage Baltic+Pacific and put 3 houses on yellow. $250 would do that and drop me under Virginia ($160), the only completable set (pinks). Illinois is only a 2/3 lottery: p1 refused Kentucky and can mortgage it for $110, so they won't sell. Still worth locking before p4 buys it as a block. If they rebid $150+, walk. Don't give Tennessee or pinks.

Walk. Ceiling stays $122: at $123+ p3 mortgages Baltic+Pacific and puts 1 house on each yellow. $185 does exactly that and leaves me $213, tight for Virginia ($160) and unable to cover light-blue 4h without heavy mortgages. Illinois is only 2/3; p1 refused Kentucky. Don't give Tennessee or pinks. Reopen only at ≤$122.

No set, no build. Don't mortgage — $363 must cover Virginia ($160) to finish pinks and mid rents. Light-blue 4h is $450–$600; if hit, mortgage PA RR first ($100), then reds before pinks/Tennessee. BW 3h ($1400) is already fatal. Don't buy Kentucky: any price that moves p1 (≥$182) funds a dark-blue house. Don't sell Tennessee (blocks p4 orange) or give p3 cash (yellows). Next buys: Virginia, NY, B&O, NC. Reopen Kentucky only if p1 is desperate and stays under $200 cash.

Shortfall $87. Mortgage PA RR for $100 — only asset that covers it without breaking the red monopoly (TN/IN/IL, 0 houses). Pinks only yield $70 each, not enough alone, and I still want Virginia to complete them. Cash after: $13. Survive, then rebuild liquidity before housing reds. Do not mortgage reds unless forced.

Cash $13 after CT 4h rent. No monopoly: pinks 2/3 (VA bank $160), reds 2/3 (p1 holds KY), orange 1/3 (TN; p4 has St. James, NY bank). Don't mortgage early — unmortgage interest; mortgage only to cover a buy or rent. Don't sell TN (orange block) or IN/IL (only trade path to a set). Don't fund p1 dark-blue houses or p3 yellows. p4 light-blue 4h is the lethal threat; BW 3h is unsurvivable even fully mortgaged. Next buys: VA, NY, B&O, NC. Reopen KY only if p1 is desperate and stays unable to hotel.
